Custom Apparel

Send your own design, logo and size chart. We cut, sew and brand it to order in your colours, by embroidery or print.

Request a quote

Customization options

  • Sizing: Made to your own size chart, not a fixed template.
  • Branding method: Embroidery or print, matched to fabric type.
  • Fabric weight: Set to suit climate and use case.
  • Colourways: Matched to your brand palette.

How to order

Send your design, logo, or a reference sample along with quantity and sizing. We'll confirm specification and get a sample underway before anything moves to bulk.
